auth_details: Free API key required via api_key query param (get at openalex.org/settings/api). Unauthenticated demo use may work limitedly.
free_tier_limits: $1/day free usage credit; singleton entity lookups free; lists/searches/content incur endpoint-based costs.
paid_plans: Prepaid/paid usage after free daily credit; higher tiers via OpenAlex pricing/contact.
rate_limits: Max 100 requests/second; daily usage limited by key credit allowance ($1 free/day).
